mainFindings: The served DTO uses the literal `product` in its metric id for a row without an evidence layer, while the consumer vocabulary calls the same row `observed`. G maps the served id explicitly (expectedDisplayId) instead of changing either side; a consumer that string-matches ids must do the same.

The served header `coverageState` still folds any partial row into `partial`, so a completely enumerated source is presented as partial (carried over from wave-29; G's own projection keeps source and row coverage separate). G did not change main.
The served document has no current-attention snapshot and no per-row unknown count; the display export states both absences instead of inventing them.
notReached: main's export endpoint: main owns HTTP/transport/App and has not wired a download route; G delivers the Node interface, the real-call harness and the CLI download path, and does not claim a served URL
an installed package carrying this wave's source: no tar with these bytes has an E verdict; 1fba/1ba/1cd/ce64 are recorded as their own subjects
real operator history and model cost baseline: none supplied — NOT_TESTED, no comparison, no benefit figure
actual_native execution: NOT_TESTED — the controlled fixture driver ran; no vendor model or native turn was performed
long-running stability and cross-machine performance: out of scope
limitations: A display export is a faithful copy of formatted strings. It cannot answer 'what was the exact number' and must not be used as if it could.
A numeric export carries numbers from the analysis summary; the cross-check parses served strings only to compare and never exports the parsed value.
Agreement is bounded by the coordinator's one-decimal rounding (0.05); a larger difference is a disagreement, not a rounding artifact.
snapshotId is the analysis summary id: two different readers of the same window produce different ids and are compared row-wise, not claimed identical.
review.activeMs stays a partial UI-visibility proxy; unknown usage/cost stay unknown; no price lookup, no benefit or causal claim.
